name: BroZoned
source: Jessie becomes Jesse when she decides to dress up as a guy to audition for a part in the world-famous boy band, BroZone. She’ll soon regret her decision as things take a dark turn.
translation: 为了参加世界知名男子偶像团体“BroZone”的选拔试镜，女孩杰茜决定女扮男装，摇身一变成了少年“杰西”。然而随着事态急转直下、滑向黑暗深渊，她很快便会为自己的决定追悔莫及。
